policies.policy_name: Administrator Role Required for SLA Definition Creation
policies.description: Creating a new SLA definition must be performed by a user whose role is **Administrator**. The Administrator role has Full CRUD access across all tables, while other roles (Manager, Agent, Reporter) do not have permission to create SLA definitions.
references: | **Administrator** (admin) | System Configuration & Integrity | Full CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) access across all tables. |

policies.policy_name: Mandatory Fields Validation for SLA Definition
policies.description: Any request to create an SLA definition must include and validate all mandatory fields (`name`, `metric`, `target_mins`, `pause_on_pending`, `active`). If any required field is missing or invalid, the operation must be stopped.
references: Mandatory Fields: Any request to create or update a record must validate all mandatory fields.

policies.description: If a request to create an SLA definition violates any policy (e.g., insufficient role, missing mandatory fields), the assistant must halt the operation immediately and return the specific policy reason before pausing.
references: Policy Violation: If a user request violates any rule herein, you must halt the operation and provide the specific policy reason before pausing.
